Anna, you're carrying a lot right now — 5 time-critical deals, two GTX Plus Pro accounts (Scotfind and Labdrill) worth $5,472 each, plus 38 orphan deals cluttering your view. Block 2 hours Tuesday morning to batch-call Scotfind and Labdrill back-to-back while you're warm — those two alone anchor most of your $17.8K at risk. Lean into entertainment, where you're running +10pp over the team; that's your closing muscle. I'll take the orphan cleanup off your plate and ride shotgun on finance so it stops bleeding. You've got this — I'm on the deals with you.

Dustin
